description: Synthetic campground, account and reservation records for reproducible checks; not a benchmark task. Three reset fixtures from one seeded generator; the manifest seed is fixtures/minimal.json. No real facility, person or payment data.

sources.description: Synthetic records written by fixtures/generate.cjs from a fixed seed: fixtures/minimal.json, the manifest seed (3 facilities, 12 sites, 22 reservations). The $10 change fee is modelled on the reference's rules page; the 15-minute hold, release schedule, refund ladders, cutoffs and alert effects are Switchback's own.

Reset fixture fixtures/high-country.json, written by fixtures/generate.cjs: 7 fictional facilities, 308 sites, 3 policy records, 11 reservations of one account, 1237 competing claims in the 180-day released window. Loaded by Infra with env.load_seed at its own clock; not the manifest seed.

Reset fixture fixtures/desert-rivers.json, written by fixtures/generate.cjs: 6 fictional facilities, 261 sites, 2 policy records, 20 reservations of one account, 1047 competing claims in the 180-day released window. Loaded by Infra with env.load_seed at its own clock; not the manifest seed.
Recreation.gov Reservation Rules and Policies page, read for one modelled rule: a $10 change fee for switching to dates entirely outside the original reservation. No text, data or assets were copied.

collection.method: Read the public page in a browser-equivalent client

transformations: Fixed UTC offsets per facility (-06:00, -07:00 or -08:00); amounts in cents; IDs stable across resets.
Rule modelled on the reference (source recgov-rules, accessed 2026-11-24T06:29:30Z): $10 change fee for a date or site change.

Switchback-defined rules: the 15-minute cart hold (the reference rules page does not state a hold time), the 180-day 07:00 release, the four-rung refund ladder, the 3-day/50% and week-out policy records, the 21:00 no-show release and 12:00 late-arrival release, the three-day refund posting, alert effects on stays and on the electric filter, and closures cancelling whole stays.
Seeded history starts on or after 2025-01-01; task clocks and scenario events are on or after 2026-01-01 (maintainer date rule, enforced by a test).

Each fixture has a default scenario schedule of 30-50 events in fixtures/schedules/. Claim instants were drawn once from OS entropy (crypto.randomInt) into fixtures/evaluator/*.claim-times.json and are never regenerated; no tool or page reads either directory.
Page icons are drawn from shapes by gui/icons.cjs (CC0 1.0) and embedded in gui/src/app.js; they are not catalog assets.
expected_counts.records counts the manifest seed's facilities, sites and reservations (3 + 12 + 22).

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace human review of realism, variation and reuse permissions.
